verdict.rationale: Anrok documents that calculated transactions are saved and tied to the relevant tax return, and that filings can be fetched via API. That covers retention and some export of tax records. The individual inputs to each calculation (address resolution, product tax category) are documented only as calculation features, not as a retained per-transaction audit record. Missing for 10: a per-transaction calculation trail showing the applied rate, rules, resolved jurisdiction and product category; a documented audit export of that trail; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, every calculation is reconstructable — the rate, rules, address resolution, and product category that produced each transaction's tax, retained and exportable for an audit
